sections.title: New Developments in Land Use Planning
sections.description:
Land use planning is an old field but not a static one. As cities and regions confront increasingly complex challenges, land use planners are adapting traditional land use tools to new circumstances. For example, how can land use programs facilitate coastal retreat and adaptation to climate change? What should be the land use responses to the demand of data centers? What land use tools can communities employ to combat social and environmental injustice?
This course examines how land use planners are reimagining and repurposing existing tools while developing new approaches to address emerging challenges. Students will learn both conceptual frameworks and analytical tools to analyze land use conflicts, evaluate alternative policy approaches, and design innovative land use planning strategies that address emerging challenges and balance competing community goals.
